summary_en: Tender offer minimum acceptance threshold lowered from 402,600 to 261,700 shares (23.56% of outstanding ex-treasury). Tender price ¥601/share unchanged. Offer period extended to 44 business days, closing 3 August 2026. Target board recommends acceptance. Goal: complete subsidiary acquisition.
title_en: Notice regarding change in tender offer terms for Yamada Corporation (TSE Code: 7426)
translation_en_brief: Nice Corporation announced on 17 July 2026 a revision to its tender offer for Yamada Corporation (TSE Standard Market, Code 7426), which commenced on 2 June 2026. The minimum acceptance threshold has been reduced from 402,600 shares to 261,700 shares, representing 23.56% of Yamada's shares outstanding (ex-treasury). The tender price remains ¥601 per ordinary share. To accommodate the revision, the offer period has been extended from the original 40 business days to 44 business days, now closing on 3 August 2026 instead of 28 July 2026. The offer carries no upper limit on shares; all tendered shares at or above the new minimum will be purchased. Nice intends to acquire 100% of Yamada (excluding Yamada's own treasury shares) and make it a wholly owned subsidiary, with squeeze-out procedures (including share consolidation) planned post-acquisition. Yamada's board continues to recommend acceptance of the offer.
